setup.title: Before you start
setup.rule: Askapeer works because nobody knows who anyone is. Every member here is a verified, registered practitioner — but no one can tell whether you're a consultant of thirty years or six months out of your degree. That is the point: ideas are judged on merit, not rank.
setup.ruleConsequence: Any attempt to identify yourself or another member — in a post, a reply, or by arranging it off the platform — results in immediate and permanent removal from Askapeer. There are no exceptions and no appeals.
setup.acknowledge: I understand, and I agree not to identify myself or any other member
setup.error: We couldn't save that. Please try again.
